newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee dips on commercial demand for dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee dips on commercial demand for dlrs.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed down against the dollar on Wednesday, mainly due to import covering demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.72 to the dollar, after opening at 58.68.
"The rupee fell due to import covering by a foreign and local bank," said a dealer.
There was also some speculation due to low call money and an expectation that the dollar would rise further overseas, dealers said.
Call money closed at 8.75 percent after opening at 9.00, dealers said.
The Central Bank's overnight repo rate was pushed down to 8.5 percent from 8.75 percent.
